mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task (id, user_id, conversation_id, task_type, status, progress, request_json, dify_conversation_id, event_sequence, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{progress}, CAST(#{requestJson} AS JSON), #{difyConversationId}, 0, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM ai_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET event_sequence = #{eventSequence}, status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, result_json = CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON)result_json, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}started_at, finished_at = #{finishedAt}finished_at, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ai_task SET dify_task_id = COALESCE(#{difyTaskId}, dify_task_id), dify_conversation_id = COALESCE(#{difyConversationId}, dify_conversation_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'RUNNING', progress = 1, result_json = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') AND version = #{version}
